component.name: AchieveTitle
component.summary: Show live Steam achievement progress in your Twitch title

description.p: AchieveTitle keeps your Twitch stream title up to date with your Steam achievement progress, for example "Chill stream [38/50 Achievements] Last: Dragon Slayer".

ul.li: Detects the Steam game you are playing
Custom title templates with achievement names and rarity
Optional OBS overlay with unlock popups
Restores your original title when you stop
